decks.name: LeetCode #73 - Set Matrix Zeroes
decks.description: Set entire rows and columns to zero if a cell contains zero

cards.question: Set Matrix Zeroes: Given an m x n integer matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0's. You must do it in place.

solutions.name: Iteration (Space Optimized)
solutions.explanation: Use the first row and first column of the matrix itself as markers to track which rows and columns need to be zeroed. Use a separate variable to track if the first row needs to be zeroed. Process the matrix in multiple passes to avoid overwriting markers prematurely.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Create a complete copy of the matrix. For each zero found in the original matrix, mark the entire row and column in the copy. Then copy the marked matrix back to the original. Uses extra space but straightforward.
